VERDICT: REPAIR
Pass 1 inspected candidate f5d0da1ef2b837684206160028c380c2e727b07c against base 1c6397c740d9b64fab471a40f493c6f6acd10bcc with matching HEAD and a clean checkout; per-criterion verdicts: AC-4 NOT SATISFIED and R-1 NOT SATISFIED because empty input returns 1 instead of throwing RangeError (src/math.mjs:69-71, test/math.test.mjs:88-89), while multiplication and shape/element rejection are satisfied (src/math.mjs:69-71); R-2 SATISFIED by nonmutating iteration/reduction and the frozen-input probe (src/math.mjs:70-71); R-3 SATISFIED by the complete diff preserving existing functions and test cases except the permitted import (src/math.mjs:1-66, test/math.test.mjs:3); R-4 SATISFIED with no dependency or generated-file changes (unchanged package.json:1-10 and complete two-file diff); R-5 SATISFIED by both product-prefixed test names (test/math.test.mjs:85,88).
Finding MEDIUM at src/math.mjs:71 and test/math.test.mjs:88-89: the missing empty-array guard violates the explicit input contract, and the new test locks in that violation; smallest verification is to assert that product([]) throws RangeError, replace the contrary expectation, and rerun the product checks.
Checks actually run: node --test --test-name-pattern="^product" test/ exited 0 with "tests 2", "pass 2", "fail 0"; npm test exited 1 with "tests 17", "pass 16", "fail 1" and only "clamp respects upper bound" failing as explicitly expected, with clamp unchanged; an independent inline assertion probe printed "PASS: multiplication, invalid shapes/elements, sparse input, frozen-input nonmutation" and "FAIL: empty input RangeError: Missing expected exception (RangeError); actual return=1", exiting 1; its initial heredoc invocation was blocked by the read-only sandbox before execution and was rerun successfully using node -e without files; all required checks ran, no files changed, no remaining uncertainty affecting the finding, and repair plus coordinator acceptance remain outstanding.
